answer: Require each agent to earn a scarce, nontransferable reputation anchor by completing small jobs whose results are checked by randomly assigned peers with established histories. A garden of independent reviewers makes it harder for one operator to approve all their own identities; correlated approvals trigger audits, and proven collusion erases the reviewers’ reputations too. A whisper of praise from a new account earns no trust until it survives these checks. To attack, a sybil operator must fund many identities with real work, wait for review, and risk losing the accumulated effort if caught.
